rect.title: sys_reset_f : ResetIn The FPGA's reset, from off the card (through the card's connector). reset net sys_reset_f (2 ports). Click for its net.
sys_clock : ClockIn From HMC7044 ch0 (Sys clk). clock net sys_clock (10 ports). Click for its net.
jesd_refclk : ClockIn From HMC7044 ch2 (Jesd refclk): transceiver reference clock. clock net jesd_refclk (3 ports). Click for its net.
jesd_sysref : SysrefIn From HMC7044 ch1 (Jesd sysref). sysref net jesd_sysref (3 ports). Click for its net.
clock_gen_spi : Spi3WireController To HMC7044 SPI (SCLK, SDATA, SLEN).
adc_jesd : JesdRx From AD9208 JESD204B (SERDOUT0..7, SYNCINB).
adc_spi : Spi3WireController To AD9208 SPI (SCLK, SDIO, CSB).
dac_jesd : JesdTx To AD9172 JESD204B (SERDIN0..7, SYNCOUT0).
dac_spi : Spi4WireController To AD9172 SPI, 4-wire (SCLK, CS, SDIO as data in, SDO).
dac_tx_en : BitOut To AD9172 TXEN0.
dac_reset : ResetOut To AD9172 RESET. reset net dac_if.dac_reset (2 ports). Click for its net.
dac_irq : BitIn From AD9172 IRQ0 (open drain, active low).
eth_rgmii : RgmiiMac To the Ethernet PHY: RGMII, 1G. Snapshots and commands.
eth_mdio : MdioController To the Ethernet PHY: MDIO management.
eth_reset_f : ResetOut To the Ethernet PHY's reset. reset net ethernet.eth_reset_f (2 ports). Click for its net.
status_uart : UartDte To the USB-UART bridge on the card: status.
temp_i2c : I2cController To TMP117 I2C (SCL, SDA).
temp_alert : BitIn From TMP117 ALERT (open drain).
ethernet : Ethernet 1G Ethernet: the MAC (RGMII to the PHY), PHY management (MDIO) and sending and receiving frames. Double-click to open its sheet.
ethernet.eth_rgmii : RgmiiMac FPGA pin. Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
ethernet.eth_mdio : MdioController FPGA pin. Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
ethernet.eth_reset_f : ResetOut FPGA pin. sampled by clk reset net ethernet.eth_reset_f. Click to choose its net.
ethernet.cmd : Axi4LiteSubordinate Commands to processing. Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
ethernet.clk : ClockIn clock net sys_clock, 100 MHz. Click to choose its net.
ethernet.rst : ResetIn reset net CLK_RST_CTRL.rst_out. Click to choose its net.
adc_if : AdcInterface The AD9208: its JESD204B link (receive) and its SPI configuration. Gives ADC samples. Double-click to open its sheet.
adc_if.adc_jesd : JesdRx FPGA pin. Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
adc_if.adc_spi : Spi3WireController FPGA pin. Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
adc_if.processing : Axi4StreamTransmitter Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
adc_if.Control : Axi4LiteSubordinate Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
adc_if.ref_clk : ClockIn clock net jesd_refclk, 150 MHz. Click to choose its net.
adc_if.rst : ResetIn reset net CLK_RST_CTRL.rst_out. Click to choose its net.
adc_if.sysref : SysrefIn sampled by ref_clk sysref net jesd_sysref, 10 MHz. Click to choose its net.
adc_if.clk : ClockIn clock net sys_clock, 100 MHz. Click to choose its net.
dac_if : DacInterface The AD9172: its JESD204B link (transmit), its SPI configuration, TXEN, reset and IRQ. Takes DAC samples. Double-click to open its sheet.
dac_if.dac_jesd : JesdTx FPGA pin. Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
dac_if.dac_spi : Spi4WireController FPGA pin. Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
dac_if.dac_tx_en : BitOut FPGA pin. Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
dac_if.dac_reset : ResetOut FPGA pin. sampled by clk reset net dac_if.dac_reset. Click to choose its net.
dac_if.processing : Axi4StreamReceiver Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
dac_if.Control : Axi4LiteSubordinate Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
dac_if.ref_clk : ClockIn clock net jesd_refclk, 150 MHz. Click to choose its net.
dac_if.rst : ResetIn reset net CLK_RST_CTRL.rst_out. Click to choose its net.
dac_if.sysref : SysrefIn sampled by ref_clk sysref net jesd_sysref, 10 MHz. Click to choose its net.
dac_if.clk : ClockIn clock net sys_clock, 100 MHz. Click to choose its net.
temp_if : TempSensorInterface The TMP117: reads the temperature over I2C on request, and watches ALERT. Double-click to open its sheet.
temp_if.temp_i2c : I2cController FPGA pin. Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
temp_if.temp_alert : BitIn FPGA pin. Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
temp_if.temp_read : Axi4LiteSubordinate Requests from processing. Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
temp_if.clk : ClockIn clock net sys_clock, 100 MHz. Click to choose its net.
temp_if.rst : ResetIn reset net CLK_RST_CTRL.rst_out. Click to choose its net.
uart : Uart Status out over the UART to the USB-UART bridge. Double-click to open its sheet.
uart.status_uart : UartDte FPGA pin. Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
uart.processing : Axi4LiteSubordinate Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
uart.clk : ClockIn clock net sys_clock, 100 MHz. Click to choose its net.
uart.rst : ResetIn reset net CLK_RST_CTRL.rst_out. Click to choose its net.
processing : Processing Takes commands from Ethernet and answers them; turns ADC samples into Ethernet packets. May hold subsystems of its own. Double-click to open its sheet.
processing.dac_if : Axi4StreamTransmitter Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
processing.adc_if : Axi4StreamReceiver Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
processing.Control : Axi4LiteSubordinate Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
processing.clk : ClockIn clock net sys_clock, 100 MHz. Click to choose its net.
processing.rst : ResetIn reset net CLK_RST_CTRL.rst_out. Click to choose its net.

CLK_RST_CTRL : CLKRSTCTRL Double-click to open its sheet.
CLK_RST_CTRL.sys_clk : ClockIn clock net sys_clock, 100 MHz. Click to choose its net.
CLK_RST_CTRL.rst_out : ResetOut sampled by sys_clk reset net CLK_RST_CTRL.rst_out. Click to choose its net.
CLK_RST_CTRL.rst : ResetIn reset net sys_reset_f. Click to choose its net.
CLK_GEN_CTRL : CLKGENCTRL Double-click to open its sheet.

CLK_GEN_CTRL.rst : ResetIn reset net CLK_RST_CTRL.rst_out. Click to choose its net.
SPI CLK_GEN_CTRL.clock_gen_spi : Spi3WireController Click, then click a component or the edge to wire it.
